title: Mjukvaruutvecklare inom MedTech
description:
**About The Job** 




 Har du minst 3 års erfarenhet som utvecklare, och vill arbeta med datadrivna lösningar inom hälsosektorn tillsammans med oss på Cubist?
 



**Vi Söker Dig Som** 



* Är civilingenjör inom datateknik, teknisk fysik eller teknisk matematik, eller har en M.Sc. inom motsvarande område
* Gillar mjukvaruutveckling och vill jobba som konsult
* Trivs i agila team och vill arbeta med utmanande problemlösning, gärna inom hälso- och sjukvårdssektorn
* Vill lära dig mer om hur man arbetar med mjukvaruutveckling i en reglerad bransch
* Vill fortsätta att utvecklas, jobba med den senaste tekniken och inspireras av smarta kunder, partners och kollegor



 För den person vi söker nu är erfarenhet av C# .Net ett krav.
 



 Vår
 **tech-stack** 
 består bland annat av teknikerna nedan - kanske kan du något av detta redan, eller så lär vi oss tillsammans!
 


* Generell backendutveckling
* Programmeringsspråk såsom C#, C/C++, Python, Java
* Docker, Kubernetes
* REST, Web Messaging
* Microservices
* Databaser såsom MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
* Cloudteknologier såsom Azure, AWS och GCP
* Message brokers såsom Kafka, RabbitMQ
* Webbramverk såsom Django, ASP.NET, React.js



 Vi arbetar både med uppdrag ute hos kund och projekt i våra lokaler på Kungsbron 21 i Stockholm.
 



**Våra kunder** 




 Ett kundexempel är
 **ImagineCare** 
 , med vilka vi i tätt samarbete utvecklar en plattform för vård på distans av patienter med olika sjukdomar. Ett annat kundexempel är
 **Kongsberg Beam Technology** 
 där vi tillsammans med kunden utvecklar metoder för förbättrad strålbehandling av cancerpatienter. Läs mer om exempel och några av våra andra intressanta projekt på https://www.cubist.eu/#what-we-do
 



**Vilka är vi?** 




 Idag består teamet av ca 30 konsulter som jobbar med medicinteknisk mjukvaruutveckling och datadrivna lösningar inom hälsosektorn.
 



 På Cubist är vi stolta över vår inkluderande företagskultur och vår vision Healthier and Happier. Vi vill bidra till hälsosektorn, så att vi alla kan känna oss
 *Healthier.* 
 Genom kompetens och erfarenhet vill vi även bidra till att vi, våra kunder och partners i Cubists community kan känna sig
 *Happier.* 
 Tillsammans strävar vi efter att leva hälsosamt, hjälpa varandra och ha kul på jobbet. Vi arbetar efter våra värderingar:
 



*Humanism* 
 . Vi jobbar för långsiktiga och hållbara förändringar som kommer till nytta för människor och samhället vi lever i. Alla ska känna sig välkomna i teamet, oavsett bakgrund.
 



*Nytänkande* 
 . Vi utmanar gärna befintliga tankesätt och strukturer och försöker att tänka nytt för att hitta kreativa lösningar. Vi försöker leva hälsosamt och hållbart, exempelvis genom att hålla nere resandet, inte köpa onödiga saker och gärna återanvända.
 



*Passion* 
 . Vi brinner för att göra skillnad i samhället och för människors liv. Vi känner stolthet över att utmana oss själva med nya tekniker och tankar i strävan mot ständigt lärande. Det bygger leveransförmåga som organisation och stärker den individuella kompetensutvecklingen.
 



  





 Låter detta spännande? Hör av dig idag och berätta om dig själv och dina ambitioner!
 



 Välkommen till Cubist!
 



 https://www.cubist.eu/

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Development at Nolimit City (part of Evolution AB) is a challenging and exciting role where you will be part of a team dedicated to creating solutions that redefine our industry. By working in small, highly collaborative teams, you and your team will have clear ownership of one of our most important new initiatives.
   

  

 At Nolimit City, we optimize for quality, fast flows, and iterative development with short feedback loops. We have a strong focus on end-to-end ownership, continuous improvement, monitoring, and experimentation. We strive to have teams that are inclusive, helpful, and have a strong sense of ownership for what they build. Our engineers make some of the most significant decisions for the company, and we are looking for open and curious developers. As part of the Nolimit City team, you will be part of one of Sweden's fastest-growing companies and contribute to creating value for our players worldwide.
   

  

 We are expanding several of our engineering teams, including the team working on new initiatives with innovative products for our end users and work on our core products.
   

  

 Although we prefer that you're working on-site we also undertand that you have a life outside of work, meaning that working remote from time to time, leaving early, coming in late etc is not something unusual for us. A bit of a cliche; but we do in fact offer a great deal of freedom but with that comes responsibility.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the product from start to finish. Decide how it is best built, tested, deployed, and monitored.
* Work with large-scale, highly available, and robust modern systems.
* Be an integral part of a team and its culture and ways of working.
* Work with automated deployment enabling release multiple times a day.
* Succeed, fail, and learn together with other competent and talented people. We believe in an environment that offers growth opportunities and see education as a result of failure that brings us closer to the next breakthrough.
* Take responsibility for system design, work together with domain architects, own end-to-end problems, manage stakeholder communication, and mentor junior engineers.


 Who you are
   

  

* Tech stack should include: JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, Java.
* Experience with advanced JavaScript libraries and frameworks
* Experience with APIs and product development
* A passion for writing clear and sustainable code
* Experience with agile methodologies, continuous integration, continuous delivery
* Good spoken and written English skills
* You thrive in an environment where you are responsible for your code and takes ownership of the change from editor to production system
* We understand that you might not have experience in all the areas listed above, but as long as you have the ambition and willingness to learn we would like to hear from you.


 Some of our technologies
   

  

* Javascript / TypeScript
* React / NextJS
* Redux / Redux-Toolkit Query
* Strapi (Headless CMS)
* Node.js and Express.js
* Java 17, Dropwizard
* MySQL
* PostgreSQL
* AWS, Ubuntu, Docker, GitHub Actions


 Who we are
   

  

 We are the best and fastest growing slot provider in the world with the operator and product in focus, and the mobile future on our minds. Nolimit is a team of experienced professionals from the gambling industry in Stockholm, Sweden, Malta and Gurugram, India. Our company has derived from hands on work at some of the most successful gambling software providers and operators over the last 15 years. Our mission is to offer a fast, reliable and flexible team that cooperates with the best operators in the world, taking gambling to the next level.
   

  

 We have a clean code high performance modern mini/micro service portable system platform for mobile and desktop that is 100 % under our own control. Since we have our own platform, this allows us to deliver special features and smooth, customizable marketing campaigns that are tailored to the operator's specific needs. We think it's time for a new angle to the gambling software industry – one where the product is in focus and we fully engage their promotion, marketing and country manager system/activities with our games. Nolimit work with customers on a global scale and the largest gambling operators in the world have our games everywhere.
   

  

 Nolimit City, Stockholm based development team. We provide you with your choice of OS and IDE.
   

  

 Send your application to hr-sweden@nolimitcity.com
   

  

 http://www.nolimitcity.com

title: Senior Software Engineer - Payments
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We're an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world feel your work.** 




  





 We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments team in Stockholm. We're a small team that owns everything that happens when someone pays Epidemic Sound: checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, refunds, tax, and payment provider integrations happens through systems we build and run. We work in short iterations where our changes bring immediate customer value.
 



  





 Our main initiative is a new purchase platform in Go: a greenfield subscription domain, built alongside today's system, including a seamless migration of live paying customers onto our new system. You'll help set and implement this technical direction.
 



  





 We’re a small and collaborative team that owns services end to end, from domain model to Terraform, on-call included. You'll work closely with Product, Finance, and the web teams whose checkout journeys sit on our APIs. AI is part of our daily toolchain, which puts more weight on judgement: we read as much code as we write.
 



  





**Your Key Responsibilities Include** 



* Own payment and subscription services end to end: design, build, deploy and monitor them.
* Build the next generation of our purchase platform in Go, and move live subscriptions onto it safely.
* Build and maintain our payment provider integrations, including the compliance-heavy parts like 3DS and SCA.
* Work in the customer-facing purchase flow in our web codebase (TypeScript) when needed.



  





**Requirements** 



* Several years building and running backend services in production, ideally in a space where correctness mattered more than shipping speed.
* Strong in Go or Python, and happy to get productive in the other. Our services are built in both.
* Good in SQL and relational data modelling. We use Postgres.
* Cloud experience, preferably Google Cloud, and comfortable owning your own infrastructure (Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform).
* Enough TypeScript and React to make changes in a shared frontend codebase, or a real interest in picking it up.
* Experience with payments, or a clear interest in it: subscriptions, billing, provider integrations, reconciliation, etc.



  





**It would also be music to our ears if you have** 



* Migrated a billing or payment platform with live customers on it.
* Worked with PSPs, card networks, 3DS and SCA, or inside PCI scope.
* Experience building event-driven services using Pub/Sub or a comparable messaging system.
* Practical experience applying AI coding agents in production, and sound judgement about when to rely on them.



  





**Equal opportunity employer** 




 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
 



  





**Application** 




 Ready to make the world feel your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Software Developer (Consultant)
description:
**What does it mean to be an IT Consultant in Software Development at Netlight?** 




 It will vary a lot between Netlighters as we, around the right person, will design a role together with you. You will be starting somewhere familiar. For example in web development? System development? Mobile Development? Data engineering? It is your call how your career at Netlight will look, ranging from which clients you will work with, what role you want to take (based on your personal experience, strengths, your personal interest) and how your relationship with your mentor/coach/EDGE networks/social networks will look like.
 



  





 As a consultant at Netlight, you will build the products, systems and technical solutions of today and tomorrow. This means that our consultants get the opportunity to help build and scale existing and new products and companies and also continuously learn and master a variety of technical tools. At Netlight, we will challenge you. Our clients will challenge you. You will challenge our clients. You will challenge us. We will grow together and unleash the potential in each other.
 



  





 Our projects are in the fields such as Backend Development, Frontend Development, Web Development, System Development, Cloud, Mobile Development, Architecture, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, DevOps, Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Scrum Master, Agile Coaching, Product Owner, UX-/UI-/Interaction Design and more.
 



  





**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Master Degree in Engineering or Technology
* Verbal and written fluency in English
* 0,5-5 years of work experience related to IT



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Proven Track-record from previous positions (e.g. recognized achievements & deliveries)
* Advanced/Bilingual (B2-C2) Swedish/Norwegian/Danish



  





**Application** 




 We are always looking for new Netlighters, so feel free to apply if you meet the qualifications. We try to get in touch within two weeks
 
 if
 
 we find that your profile and experiences are a match beyond the qualifications at this time.
 



  





**About us** 




 Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. We are a network organization of more than 2 000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. Netlight has been awarded several times as top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity and equality within the IT industry. Today we are growing all across Europe, currently with more than 13 active international offices.
 



  





**Come work with us** 




 Netlight strives to be a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive organization. Regardless of who you are, what personality, background, and experience you have, you enrich our culture through your values. Netlight’s purpose is to unleash full potential, realize great careers, and fulfill personal growth. To achieve this, we have a highly engaged network organization, where every employee gets a mentor, delivery coach and personal communities. The key to our continued success is trust and personal responsibility, diverse experiences, challenging opportunities and developing from personal values. Every Netlighter is an active part of building and shaping this culture, which leads to a clear correlation between personal growth and the growth of Netlight.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Product
description:
**Do you want to build a product end-to-end in a small, AI-native team, from domain model to shipped feature?** 




  





 Atmoz is seeking an exceptional Staff Software Engineer to drive product development on our agentic carbon accounting platform end-to-end, from backend architecture and calculation logic to a feature being live with customers.
 



  





 We build with high leverage: agentic engineering (Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, and similar) is our normal way of working, not an add-on. That means a single engineer here owns more, moves faster, and shapes the product more than in a traditional team.
 



  





**Why Atmoz?** 




  





 Atmoz is building an agentic platform for climate data and carbon accounting. We combine the latest technology with real climate expertise to help companies collect data, calculate emissions, and produce climate reporting they can trust.
 



  





 We are a small team with high ambitions. With us, you get significant responsibility and the opportunity to shape our customers' experience, our product, and how we build it. The role is based at our office in Stockholm (Norrsken House) and the work is hybrid.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 The role's center of gravity is backend: Go, Python, Postgres, GraphQL, API design, domain modeling, and calculation logic. This is where most of our technical complexity lives. Frontend we largely build by prompting Lovable, in close collaboration with product and design; you need to be able to review, debug, and harden TypeScript/React code, but you don't need to be a frontend specialist.
 



  





 You'll report directly to our CTO and work closely with our Head of Product, designer and engineering team. No intermediaries, no detailed specs: you drive features from idea to production yourself.
 



  





**Among other things, you will:** 




  




* Drive backend development on our Go/Python/GraphQL platform: API design, domain modeling, calculation logic, and integrations.
* Build and harden the frontend together with product and design, with Lovable as the primary tool.
* Work agent-first across the whole flow (code, documentation, testing) and continuously evolve how we build with AI.
* Work closely with our Principal Engineer on the platform's application architecture.
* Get close to our customers and their problems, and bring what you learn back into the product and the roadmap.
* Contribute across the stack when needed. In a small team there are no lanes.



  





**We think you have** 




  




* Typically 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with several years of end-to-end responsibility for backend systems in production.
* Deep backend experience, ideally in Go and Python, and experience designing APIs and domain models for complex business domains.
* Solid understanding of systems design, performance trade-offs, and scalable architecture, plus the judgment to know which of them actually matter for the problem at hand.
* An AI-native way of working: agentic engineering is your default mode, and you can show how your own workflow has changed over the past year.
* Enough TypeScript/React fluency to review and improve generated frontend code.
* Experience independently owning a product surface at a small company, from idea to production.
* Strong product sense: you can work directly with product and design without detailed specs.
* Genuine curiosity about customers and the problems they're trying to solve. You ask why before you build, and you use that understanding to make good calls on your own and to shape the roadmap. You don't need to know carbon accounting already; you do need to want to understand it.
* A bias for shipping: you prioritize making progress and solving real customer problems over building the perfect technical solution, and you know where that trade-off doesn't apply.
* A generalist's instincts: deep on backend but comfortable moving between functions as needs shift.
* Excellent English, spoken and written; Swedish is a plus.



  





**It's a plus if you have** 




  




* Founded a company or been an early hire at a startup.
* Production experience with GraphQL.
* Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure.
* Worked with climate data, carbon accounting, or adjacent domains.
* Experience with EU data protection (GDPR) in product decisions.



  





**You'll thrive here if you** 




  




* Want real ownership of architecture, code, and outcomes, rather than executing someone else's plan.
* Are low-ego and comfortable both making decisions and doing the work yourself.
* Would rather ship something real this week and iterate than polish something perfect for a month. Progress and customer value first.
* Are rigorous without getting stuck in perfectionism.
* Enjoy talking to customers and understanding their world, not just the technical problem.
* Enjoy a small company where priorities can shift quickly.
* Like taking initiative, working at a high pace, and being challenged by new problems.
* Are curious about the latest developments in AI tooling and platform patterns, and actually put them to use.



  





**Our tech stack** 




  





 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
 



  




* Frontend: React, Vite
* Backend: Go, Python and PostgreSQL
* Cloud: GCP, Snowflake, Kubernetes
* Orchestration and ingestion: Dagster, dbt, Airbyte
* DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (OpenTofu)
* AI & agents: Claude Code, Codex, Lovable



  





 And always on the lookout for what's next!
 



  





 We've spent the last nine months rebuilding from the ground up and just launched, so you'll join early enough to shape the conventions and the architecture rather than inherit them.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
 



  





 To keep the process fair for everyone, we review all applications through our careers portal, so please apply there rather than by email.
 



  





**Start date: As soon as possible**

title: Senior Nativeutvecklare till ICA Checkout & Scanna
description:
Vill du utveckla robusta checkout- och scannalösningar som används i ICAs butiker? Vi söker en senior Androidutvecklare med stark nativebakgrund som vill kombinera modern mobilutveckling med hårdvarunära teknik.
   

  

 Om jobbet som Senior Nativeutvecklare
   

  

 Du blir en del av teamet som utvecklar ICAs checkout- och scannalösningar. Målet är att skapa en snabb, enkel och intuitiv köpupplevelse, oavsett kassakanal. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från design och utveckling till testning, driftsättning och förvaltning. Lösningarna integrerar med fysisk utrustning som scanners, vågar och betalutrustning. Därför är stabilitet, prestanda och genomtänkt felhantering centralt.
   

  

 Teamet arbetar med:
   

  

* Kotlin och native Android
* Jetpack Compose
* Kotlin Multiplatform, KMP
* Hårdvaru- och API-integrationer
* Testautomatisering och DevOps


 Du samarbetar nära utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och testare. Kunskapsdelning, gemensam problemlösning och ansvar för produkt och leverans är viktiga delar av arbetssättet.
   

  

 Är du den vi söker?
   

  

 Du har flerårig erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Kotlin och native Androidutveckling
* Jetpack Compose
* Hårdvarunära utveckling eller integration med fysisk utrustning
* Utveckling av robusta, testbara och driftsäkra lösningar
* Agil produktutveckling i tvärfunktionella team


 Erfarenhet av KMP, iOS, backendutveckling i .NET eller Microsoft Azure är meriterande. Som person är du självgående, samarbetsorienterad och kvalitetsmedveten. Du är nyfiken på nya tekniker, delar gärna kunskap och bidrar aktivt i tekniska vägval. Du kommunicerar väl på svenska och engelska.
   

  

 Därför ska du välja ICA
   

  

 Hos oss får du utveckla affärskritiska lösningar som påverkar kund- och butiksupplevelsen varje dag. Rollen kombinerar modern Androidutveckling, komplex problemlösning och långsiktigt tekniskt ansvar.
   

  

 Övrigt
   

  

 Ansök senast 18/10 – 26, vi gör löpande urval så tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kontakta Hanna Hedqvist, rekryterande chef på hanna.hedqvist@ica.se. Har du frågor kring urval och process kontakta Markus Öhman, rekryterare, +46 76 695 62 04.
   

  

 ICA ska spegla våra kunder och samhället. Vi strävar därför efter att anställa människor med olika bakgrund, kompetenser, kunskap och erfarenheter. Om rollen kräver det behöver du genomgå tester, bakgrundskontroller och drogtestning innan anställning.

title: Senior L1 Software Engineer – 5G/6G Baseband
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled
 **L1 Software Engineer** 
 to join Huawei’s Sweden Research Center in Stockholm and contribute to the research, architecture, design, and implementation of next-generation wireless baseband systems.
   

  

 In this role, you will work on advanced
 **Layer 1 (Physical Layer) software technologies** 
 for future wireless RAN systems. You will be responsible for translating advanced wireless algorithms into highly efficient real-time software implementations running on heterogeneous baseband computing platforms, including DSPs, CPUs, ASIC accelerators, and other specialized processing architectures.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with wireless algorithm researchers, SoC architects, DSP designers, compiler experts, and system engineers to develop high-performance and energy-efficient Layer 1 solutions for next-generation wireless communication systems.
   

  

 Your work will directly contribute to Huawei's future wireless baseband architecture, software platform, and product competitiveness.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 You will contribute to the design, development, optimization, and validation of high-performance Layer 1 software for next-generation wireless RAN systems.
   

  

**Layer 1 Software Development**
* Design and optimize Layer 1 / Physical Layer software for 5G evolution and next-generation wireless systems.
* Develop real-time uplink and downlink baseband processing software.
* Translate wireless algorithms into efficient implementations for embedded and heterogeneous baseband platforms.
* Contribute to software architecture, module interfaces, data flow, and execution pipeline design.


**PHY Algorithm Implementation & Optimization**
* Implement and optimize key PHY functions, including channel estimation, MIMO detection and precoding, beamforming, OFDM, synchronization, LDPC/Polar coding, HARQ, and Massive MIMO processing.
* Evaluate implementation complexity, numerical accuracy, latency, throughput, and resource requirements.
* Optimize workloads using SIMD/vectorization, multi-core parallelism, pipeline optimization, memory/cache optimization, DMA, and fixed-point techniques.
* Analyze performance bottlenecks using profiling, tracing, and performance models.


**Software–Hardware Co-Design**
* Collaborate with DSP, SoC, accelerator, compiler, and hardware teams to optimize Layer 1 workloads for target platforms.
* Analyze workload characteristics and derive processor, memory, interconnect, and accelerator requirements.
* Contribute to hardware/software partitioning and evaluation of new processor instructions, accelerators, and memory architectures.


**Next-Generation Wireless Technologies**
* Investigate advanced PHY technologies and computing architectures for 5G-Advanced and 6G.
* Develop proof-of-concept implementations for new algorithms and architectures.
* Explore AI/ML-enabled physical-layer processing and contribute to future baseband software and SoC roadmaps.


**Preferred Technical Expertise**
* Strong knowledge of 4G/5G NR Layer 1, OFDM, Massive MIMO, beamforming, channel estimation, MIMO processing, coding, HARQ, and link adaptation.
* Experience with DSP, SIMD/vector processors, multi-core architectures, ARM/x86, embedded systems, or real-time software.
* Strong skills in C/C++, parallel programming, memory optimization, low-latency software, and performance profiling.
* Experience with ASIC/DSP/CPU/FPGA/accelerator-based baseband platforms and software–hardware co-design.
* Knowledge of AI/ML for wireless PHY or AI accelerator architectures is a plus.


**Qualifications**
* PhD, MSc, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communication, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience, preferably in 4G/5G Layer 1 or wireless baseband development.
* Experience developing or optimizing large-scale, high-performance software systems.
* Experience with multi-core, DSP, FPGA, or accelerator-based heterogeneous computing platforms.


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong interest in wireless communications and high-performance computing.
* Strong system-level thinking and performance awareness.
* Ability to translate complex algorithms into efficient software implementations.
* Self-driven with strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.


**Other**
* The candidates should have highly developed skills in finding new innovative solutions, strategic visions and ability of leading and driving activities.


**Location: Stockholm, Sweden**
 For more information regarding the position:
   

  

**Tommy Deng**
 phone: +46 739200807
   

  

 Email: zhongmin.deng@huawei.com
   

  

**Elisabeth Ekström**
 HR Specialist
   

  

**E-mail:** 
**elisabeth.ekstrom1@h-partners.com**

title: Junior Cloud RAN Layer 1 SW Developer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 Are you about to graduate, or have you recently completed your university studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field?
   

  

 Join Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks.
   

  

 Our teams develop performance-critical software at the heart of 5G and future radio systems. As a Junior Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced developers and technical experts to learn how advanced wireless communication systems are designed, implemented, tested, and optimized.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and excited about solving challenging technical problems in a collaborative environment.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Develop and maintain software in Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 platform.
* Use AI-assisted engineering workflows to support activities such as developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review.
* Work with modern C++ and performance-critical software components.
* Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work.
* Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities.
* Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams.
* Contribute to software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement.
* Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product, including prototyping, integration, testing, and evaluation together with experienced engineers.
* Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience.

title: AI-First Senior Software Engineer
description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.
   

  

 We're looking for an experienced
 **AI-First Senior Software Engineer** 
 for our Stockholm office.
   

  

 This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software
 *engineers* 
 , not software
 *developers* 
 . AI has hyper-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.
   

  

 Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and
 *sustainable* 
 software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* System design. Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
* Domain modelling. Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the right solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
* Architectural patterns. Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
* Process design — the core responsibility. Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as orchestrator–worker (an orchestrator decides sub-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and evaluator–optimizer (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
* Quality judgment. Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line-by-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
* Tooling — the right tool for the job. Fluency across product-development tools, AI-acceleration (code-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
* Accountability. You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.


**Your profile**
* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
* An early adopter of AI-first development, with proven, in-production experience implementing AI-first software development processes — not just experimenting with tooling
* Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow-vs-agent decisions)
* Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
* Test design, feedback-loop design and validation skills over line-by-line review
* Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI-accelerated pipelines
* Infrastructure / CI-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
* Domain-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
* Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
* Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
* Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken


**Tools you'll work with**
* AI-acceleration: Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
* Languages & engineering: .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code-review practice
* Workflow orchestration: agent frameworks and multi-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
* Infrastructure: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
* Quality control: automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI-assisted output


**Meritorious**
* Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
* Experience standing up AI-first processes at team or organisation scale
* LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
* Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
* Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience


**What this role is not**
 It is not a prompt-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase
 *less* 
 reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.
   

  

**We're Looking For Someone Who Is**
* Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
* Accountable and self-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
* Communicative and a team player; resilient under the cognitive load of carrying large context (we build teams with fail-over and redundancy, because AI burn-out is real)
* Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects


**With us you get**
* A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
* A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
* A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.


**Selected benefits**
* Opportunity for part-ownership
* Competitive fixed salary
* 30 days holiday
* Company laptop, phone and subscription


 Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.
   

  

 Engineering judgement, accelerated — that's how we make IT easy.

title: Wireless Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
   

  

 Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
   

  

 Keysight is looking for a RAN-focused wireless software engineer with deep 3GPP expertise to help build and evolve test, emulation, and validation solutions used across the wireless ecosystem—spanning device, chipset, network infrastructure, and Open RAN. You’ll work close to standards and real implementations, translating specifications into robust software capabilities that enable customers to validate conformance, interoperability, and performance across the RAN lifecycle.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone coming from a leading RAN organization who enjoys working at the intersection of
 **3GPP specs** 
 ,
 **real network behavior** 
 , and
 **high-quality software** 
 .
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do**
* Design and implement software capabilities aligned to 3GPP LTE/NR (e.g., RRC, PDCP/RLC/MAC, PHY interactions, procedures, state machines, timers, KPI/measurement semantics).
* Convert evolving requirements (3GPP releases, operator acceptance needs, O-RAN priorities) into clear software designs, test workflows, and reusable components.
* Build and maintain automation and tooling for protocol conformance, interoperability, and performance validation for RAN-facing scenarios.
* Collaborate with cross-functional experts (systems, RF, protocol, product, customers/partners) to reproduce field issues, debug complex behaviors, and deliver fixes with strong root-cause discipline.
* Create high-signal artifacts: design docs, test plans, trace/pcap interpretations, and technical notes that stand up to scrutiny from senior telecom engineers.
* Contribute to solution evolution for modern RAN architectures including Open RAN / O-RAN interfaces and multi-vendor environments.


**What You’ll Work With**
* Open RAN / RAN & Core validation: automated suites enabling conformance, interoperability, performance, security, and energy-efficiency validation across the test lifecycle.
* 5G network emulation: solutions covering NR, sub-6 and mmWave use cases and test domains; software paired with network emulation platforms to emulate 5G NR network behavior and configure standards-compliant testing.
* RAN measurement & optimization tooling (as applicable): field test/verification support for advanced 5G NR technologies like DSS, beamforming, massive MIMO, and O-RAN.


**Qualifications**
* Strong, hands-on expertise in 3GPP LTE/NR with a clear RAN focus (e.g., L1/L2/L3 procedures, scheduling concepts, mobility, bearers, signaling flows, performance metrics).
* Professional software engineering experience (typically 8+ years, but we value depth and scope over a number).
* Strong coding skills in C/C++ (and/or modern Python for automation/tooling); comfortable in Linux development environments.
* Proven ability to debug distributed/real-time systems: logs, traces, protocol analyzers, KPIs, timing, performance bottlenecks.
* Clear technical communication in English (written and verbal), including turning complex spec-driven topics into implementable requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with RAN product development (gNB/eNB), RAN performance optimization, or feature verification in complex system environments.
* Familiarity with O-RAN architecture/interfaces (O-RU/O-DU/O-CU, fronthaul, RIC concepts) and multi-vendor integration challenges.
* Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, containers, and/or cloud-based deployment environments.
* Prior exposure to standards work (3GPP RAN1/2/4/5) or strong experience implementing features directly from evolving specs.


**What Success Looks Like**
* You quickly establish credibility by translating ambiguous, spec-heavy problems into concrete implementations and testable outcomes.
* You raise quality and repeatability: better automation, clearer diagnostics, and fewer bugs.
* You help steer solution direction by identifying what matters most to RAN engineers, labs, and operators—and making it real in software.
* You will thrive working with a highly technical, cross-disciplinary team building solutions used across the wireless ecosystem.

title: Senior Principal Runtime Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Runtime team at Sambanova is a seasoned engineering team with a proven track record of delivering cutting-edge system software solutions for AI and machine learning applications in the enterprise & commercial landscape.
   

  

 Runtime is responsible for the lowest levels of the SambaNova stack, efficiently interacting with the hardware to provide the best application performance and maximize hardware utilization. We handle all aspects of software infrastructure to enable higher level applications, including:
   

  

* High performance user libraries
* Operating System interface/integration
* Data model manipulation for scaling
* Networking/communication intra and inter node
* Orchestration of partitioned workloads
* Error monitoring and tools for system management and observability


 We build a high performance, distributed and scalable software execution environment for SambaNova DataScale & Cloud platforms to support data-flow applications such as ML training and inference and HPC applications.
   

  

 We are searching for a software engineer who will work on all parts of the runtime stacks, supporting AI, ML, and scientific applications in high-performance distributed systems. You will participate in building, testing and deploying next-generation high-performance compute systems for AI applications at scale. We expect the candidate to have a strong background in programming, building and testing software in distributed systems, performance tuning of large scale systems, and good teamwork and planning skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on design and implementation of new and enhanced features of the runtime stack to support high performance and scalable ML inference and training applications
* System software (drivers and kernel) support for the next generation silicon.
* Design user-space libraries for high performance and high utilization of HW resources.
* User-facing tools (analysis, job and HW management, profiling, debugging, etc) for Datascale systems.
* Collaborate with other teams including Hardware, ML Application, Compiler, DevOps.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent and with 3-5 years of industry experience
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python
* Experience with user space libraries, operating systems, and kernel drivers
* Experience working with highly concurrent and distributed systems, with a focus on performance and scalability


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with different types of fabrics, such as PCIe, Infiniband, and RoCE
* Experience with fast networking stacks, such as RDMA
* Good communication skills and enthusiasm to help colleagues


**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.
   

  

**EEO Policy**
 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions**
 SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

You'll work across the ML lifecycle from understanding data and selecting the right algorithms to building pipelines, deploying models, and monitoring them in production.
   

  

 You'll also help us develop more effective ways of working with AI. This includes using AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows and building reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based solutions. The goal is practical impact: delivering faster, reducing technical debt, improving access to knowledge, and creating reliable systems that are easier to develop and maintain.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who understands that AI can significantly improve how we work but that great solutions still depend on high-quality data, sound ML principles, critical thinking, and thoughtful engineering.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models for recommendations, predictions, classification, and personalization
* Build and maintain scalable data and ML pipelines in a modern cloud environment
* Use AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows to turn clear requirements into tested, production-ready solutions
* Build reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based tools that support data, ML, and engineering teams
* Apply AI to improve existing systems, automate repetitive work, and reduce technical debt
* Collaborate with product, engineering, data science, content, commercial, and marketing teams
* Monitor models and pipelines to ensure they remain reliable, understandable, and effective.


**What We’re Looking For**
 We're seeking someone who combines technical depth with strategic thinking and a curious, problem-solving mindset.
   

  

 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:
   

  

* 3+ years of experience applying machine learning or data science in production
* A solid understanding of data, statistics, and core ML algorithms - including how to select and evaluate the right approach
* Experience taking ML projects from problem definition and experimentation through deployment and monitoring
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using Spark or similar data-processing technologies
* Experience building data pipelines and using orchestration tools such as Airflow
* Practical experience with or strong curiosity about generative AI, AI agents, and AI-assisted engineering
* The ability to review and validate AI-generated output rather than treating it as automatically correct
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative, curious approach to problem-solving


**It’s a bonus if you have:** 
  

  

* Experience with recommender systems, search, ranking, or personalization.
* Experience building AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, or internal knowledge tools
* Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, MLOps, CI/CD, and observability
* Experience in streaming, media, e-commerce, or another digital product environment


**You don't need to meet every requirement to apply. We value different perspectives, a willingness to learn, and people who are excited to explore how strong ML foundations and modern AI can work together to create meaningful products.**
 What we offer you
   

  

* We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.


**Hit play today**
 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Why Doktor.se
   

  

 Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.
   

  

 We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows — and that footprint is growing fast. AI is a working tool here, not a buzzword. We use it daily, we expect you to as well, and we hire people who treat it as a force multiplier.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Our data platform works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We have data scattered across Postgres databases, Amplitude, S3 file dumps, and a tangle of Python jobs that move it around. The reports get built and the business runs on them. But trust is brittle, reconciliation is too manual, and the foundations need work before we can scale to where we're going.
   

  

 We need someone who can help us rebuild this — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where the warehouse is clean and the pipelines just run, this isn't it. If you want to redesign a data platform from foundations up, with real ownership and the leverage to make it good, here's what you'd own:
   

  

* Reshape the data foundations — multi-tenancy, retention, and data contracts with backend services.
* Decide what the warehouse actually is: self-hosted Postgres + dbt, managed Snowflake or BigQuery, or something else. You'll shape this.
* Unify three data sources that don't currently talk to each other: our operational databases, Amplitude product analytics, and a long tail of S3-based partner integrations.
* Build observability into the platform — lineage, freshness, and alerting that actually means something.
* Own reporting that finance, operations, and the board rely on. Make those reports trustworthy by design, not by manual reconciliation.
* Work directly with backend, product, and finance teams. You're not a service desk — you're a peer who shapes how data gets produced upstream, not just consumed downstream.
* Use AI aggressively for pipeline boilerplate, schema generation, transformation logic, and exploratory analysis — the same discipline we hold ourselves to.


 You'll be part of a small data engineering team. That's a lot of ownership and not a lot of cover. The right person sees that as opportunity.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

* You've designed and run data platforms in production — not just written DAGs. You've thought about what to build vs buy, where transformations belong, and how to keep schemas honest as products evolve.
* You're fluent in Python and SQL, with strong opinions about how Postgres should be used as a warehouse (and when it shouldn't).
* You've used dbt or equivalent in a real environment and understand data modelling — staging, marts, tests.
* You have working knowledge of one or more managed warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and can evaluate them honestly against self-hosted options.
* You're comfortable with orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, whichever — and know what an orchestrator is for.
* You think about data contracts as a product problem, not just a pipeline problem, and can make that case to backend engineers.
* You use AI in your daily work and can talk about how. If your answer is "I haven't really tried it yet," this isn't the role.
* Healthcare data experience is a plus. GDPR fluency is expected. Patientdatalagen familiarity is a bonus.
* You have a relevant university degree or equivalent experience.


 Tech stack
   

  

* Sources: Postgres (operational), Amplitude (events), S3 (integrations and dumps)
* Languages: Python, SQL
* Cloud: AWS, multi-account
* Warehouse: Postgres today, open question for tomorrow
* Transformation: likely dbt going forward
* Orchestration: open question — you'll shape this
* AI: Claude and OpenAI in our daily workflow


 What we offer
   

  

* Real influence. The data platform is being rebuilt and you're at the centre of it.
* Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers — your work is visible, not lost in a machine.
* Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.
* Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.


 Practical details
   

  

* Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.
* Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.
* Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.
* Language: You'll be working with our entire org so Swedish is a strong plus, but English is our working language within tech.
* Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.


 We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.
   

  

 På Doktor.Se vill vi göra saker annorlunda. Vi vill utmana och förändra en hel bransch. Allt började med en idé om att det måste gå att skapa en vårdlösning som är bättre anpassad till vår tid och våra behov. Att det måste gå att få moderna digitala verktyg och traditionell fysisk vård att samverka med utgångspunkt i patientens behov. Och att göra det så att det inte bara blir tillgängligt för våra patienter utan också bidrar till att utveckla det sätt som vård erbjuds på idag. För oss alla. Det här är faktiskt vad vi gör idag. Men vi är långt ifrån klara och är ute på en spännande förändringsresa. Där kan du få vara med och bidra.

title: AI Engineer - Customer Operations
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We are building an agentic layer that works Vainu's own accounts, pipeline, support, and renewals in the background. You will build those agents and own them, across CS, Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you are a curious builder with a commercial mindset that has shipped real systems with real users, keep reading.
   

  

**Vainu’s AI thesis**
 We are headless-first. We believe the primary user of our software will be an agent, not a person.
   

  

 Already now, every capability is reachable through APIs, CLI tools, and MCP servers. A GUI will be something for humans afterwards, if it earns its place.
   

  

**A Glimpse Of What Your Work Will Entail**
 You will contribute to building Vainu's agentic layer: the systems that let agents support our commercial work in the background, across multiple departments. It is a new layer with a small team, so you will have the opportunity to impact and shape the next big shift at Vainu. What you will do would include:
   

  

* Building autonomous customer processes. One knowledge layer that updates itself from customer conversations, product releases, and other events that change what is true about Vainu, and agents that use it to answer questions across email, phone, chat, Slack, and in-product. You build the whole loop: the agent that answers, and the pipeline that keeps it right. Success is when our team can focus on conversations where human interaction creates most value.
* Orchestrating Growth agents. Agents that read customer usage, health, and signals against our offering, then flag expansion, risk, and timing with sources attached. They write CRM entries, create opportunities, send emails, and pull a human in when a human is the right move.
* Prove that it works. Every agent has to beat the process it replaces, and you have to show it. Named tests that can go red, monitoring in production, honest comparison against how the work was done before. We would rather kill an agent than run one that quietly performs worse than manual handling.


 Our goal is for agents to handle routine parts of customer processes, freeing us to do the work where we create most value.
   

  

**What We Need To See**
* You have built things people have used. A company you started, an automation that ran your team's workflow, a tool, an agent, a side project with users who were not you. No technical degree is required, only proof of what you have built.
* You operate comfortably with dev tools. LLMs, APIs, n8n, Git, GCP, and whatever the problem needs next. When the right tool is one you have never touched, you have something running in it by the end of the week.
* You are business-curious. You want to know how a technical decision shows up in pipeline, retention, and revenue.
* You will be handed problems nobody here knows how to solve. No runbook, no spec. Take the problem regardless, work out what it is, find the tooling, come back with something running. Then tell us straight what it does and does not do yet.


**What You Get**
 Most people spend five years choosing between the commercial track and the technical one. This role is both from day one. You sit close enough to sales, CS, Marketing, and RevOps to see where money is won and lost, and you build the systems that change it.
   

  

 You will work independently on your projects but together with a small and ambitious team similar to your capabilities. You will work closely with your team and with consultation from the founders to build out Vainu’s agentic layer.
   

  

 We will not shield you from the hard problems, because the hard problems are the training. If you want to start a company one day, this is a place for you.
   

  

**About Vainu**
 The Nordics' leading company database: over 5.1M companies and 10.5M decision-makers, collected by us and refreshed daily. Finnish-born, offices in Stockholm and Helsinki, around 80 people. Founder-owned and profitable, with more than 1,100 customers across the Nordics.
   

  

 The Vainu database can be accessed through three products:
   

  

* Reach. TAM and ICP. Filter millions of companies and decision-makers down to the ones worth contacting.
* Data Sync. Customer 360. One full picture of every customer, real time
* Discover. Vainu agents that tell companies when and why to reach out.


**Work setup and salary**
 Location: Helsinki or Stockholm office. Full-time in the office for the first 6 months, then 2-3 days per week in the office.
   

  

 Base salary: 4.000 € - 5.500 € (monthly gross salary). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and what you've shipped.
   

  

 Questions: Contact Pauliina (pauliina@vainu.io or +358 44 238 8007)
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Send us three things:
   

  

* CV and Cover Letter
* Something you built, with a link. Repo, product, agent, automation, a company. Something real, not a demo reel.
* One paragraph on a Vainu workflow you would automate first, and why. Guess. We want to see how you think, not whether you know our stack.


 We read every application that includes all three, and we move fast.

title: Master Thesis: Open Knowledge Format
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Ericsson Customer Product Information (CPI), the documentation delivered to customers, must match the technical design, the CPI template requirements, and the applicable release and configuration. In an agentic CPI workflow, locating evidence in input documents and determining which CPI topics a change affects are of vital importance.
   

  

 This master’s thesis will investigate how metadata annotations, ontologies, and document templates can improve CPI generation and maintenance. The aim is to design and evaluate an AI-assisted prototype that connects annotated design information to CPI template requirements and dynamically assembles applicable content for a selected release and configuration. The solution should flag missing evidence, trace content to its sources, and identify affected topics when designs or template requirements change. Design knowledge will reside in a semantic layer combining a structured knowledge base with an ontology-based knowledge graph. Portable Open Knowledge Format (OKF) concept bundles, built and exchanged with Apache Ossie, will capture source knowledge, while the graph will link concepts, evidence, and CPI topics.
   

  

 Conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) feeds isolated text chunks to large language models (LLMs), so it breaks document semantics, overlooks dependencies between entities, and lags behind changes in siloed sources. The prototype’s drafts and updates will be compared with this baseline to evaluate factual accuracy, completeness, traceability, update correctness, and authoring and review effort.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Review relevant literature and current approaches for documentation generation, knowledge representation, and graph-based RAG (GraphRAG).
* Study CPI template requirements and define annotations and an ontology linking design concepts, topics, releases, and configurations.
* Design and implement a FastAPI prototype that uses Apache Ossie to ingest design proposals, interface specifications, and schemas into validated OKF concept bundles, organised in a knowledge base and linked through an ontology-based knowledge graph.
* Implement GraphRAG, combining vector search with graph traversal, so that LLMs assemble applicable topics with traceable references and flag missing evidence.
* Identify the CPI topics affected when designs or template requirements change, regenerate them, and check that unaffected topics remain correct.
* Create an appropriately protected dataset, including controlled changes to designs and template requirements, and establish reference topics reviewed by experienced CPI authors.
* Compare results with the RAG baseline using measures such as claim accuracy, content coverage, citation validity, affected-topic precision and recall, correctness of regenerated topics, and authoring and review time.
* Analyse limitations, data-quality dependencies, and suitable human oversight for CPI authoring.


**The skills you bring:**
* Master’s-level studies in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
* Proficiency in Python, including asynchronous programming, and experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and RAG.
* Familiarity with FastAPI or a similar web framework, PostgreSQL or vector databases, and Docker.
* Ability to work with structured and unstructured technical documentation.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL ontologies, OKF, data pipelines, frontend tooling, or open-source practices is an advantage.
* Interest in empirical evaluation, technical documentation, and responsible AI.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.
   

  

 With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.
   

  

 Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.
   

  

**About the role:**
 Join Team Cloud as a Senior Cloud Engineer. You will help build and run the shared cloud platform that every development team at Aira depends on, and make it easier for them to ship secure and reliable software.
   

  

 We run a deliberately thin platform. Teams at Aira are autonomous and own their own systems, so our job is to make the good path the easy one rather than to run infrastructure on anyone's behalf. That makes the work as much about understanding what teams actually need, and knowing how to get something adopted across the organisation, as about building it. It is a small team with a large surface, so you will need to own your work end to end.
   

  

**What you’ll be doing:**
* The cloud platform itself: the networking, identity and security foundations that everything at Aira runs on, built once and built well, so that teams inherit them instead of assembling their own.
* CI/CD (GitHub Actions) as a product: our pipelines are becoming the place where quality is enforced — vulnerability scanning, secure infrastructure, and static code analysis as we grow.
* The operational platform: Kubernetes, Kafka and observability, run as an offering rather than as a set of servers.
* The rest of the offering: cloud and developer access, the internal tools and services we host, and the on- and offboarding around them.
* Shaping the plan: we have a roadmap, and you will be part of refining it and working out what matters next.


**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* AWS and Terraform. You have built production infrastructure with them, and been responsible for it when it broke.
* Several years of building and operating systems other people depend on.
* Pragmatism. You take security and correctness seriously, and you can tell when taking them further would cost more than it is worth.
* Independence, and the instinct to involve others. You do not need step-by-step direction, and when a decision needs several people you get them together.
* Thoughtful use of AI. We expect you to use it, and to be able to say where it helped you, where it failed you, and what you did about it.
* Communication. You can explain a technical decision to someone who does not share your background, in writing and in conversation. Most of your colleagues are not native English speakers.
* Opinions, and the willingness to change them. Tell us when you think we are wrong, and get behind a decision once it has been made.
* A degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or similar — or the experience to stand in its place. What we are really after is the reasoning ability that comes with it.


***What we work with:***
 We would expect you to know a good part of this well, and to be willing to learn the rest.
   

  

  

* Cloud and infrastructure
* Kubernetes and Kafka – we used the managed versions AWS EKS, AWS MSK.
* CDK Terrain, the community continuation of CDKTF, which is how we write much of our infrastructure.
* Observability tooling and alerting – Prometheus, Grafana and CloudWatch.
* Administering Google Cloud (and Azure) alongside AWS.
* Delivery and developer tooling
* GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Vulnerability, dependency and container scanning.
* Static code analysis tools.
* Languages and everyday tools
* Java is the most prominent language among our development teams. TypeScript, Kotlin, Go, Rust and Flutter are all in use as well.
* Fluency with the standard Unix command-line tools and a terminal editor.


**What is in it for you?**
* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

**Om rollen**
 OKQ8 etablerar ett nytt Platform Engineering Team i Stockholm. Teamet blir en central del av vår fortsatta transformationsresa och ska skapa det tekniska fundament som gör det möjligt för organisationen att arbeta snabbare, säkrare och mer skalbart.
   

  

 Teamet kommer att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och nära våra utvecklings-, infrastruktur-, nätverks- och cybersäkerhetsteam. Tillsammans ska ni omsätta vår nya cloud- och infrastrukturstrategi till moderna, standardiserade och automatiserade plattformskapabiliteter. Arbetet bedrivs enligt DevOps-principer med fokus på automation, Infrastructure as Code, återanvändbarhet och self-service.
   

  

 Som Senior Cloud Engineer får du en senior teknisk nyckelroll med ansvar för att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla vår Azure-plattform. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt och bidrar till att omsätta målarkitektur och cloudstrategi till fungerande, säkra och skalbara lösningar.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Designa och vidareutveckla Azure-plattformen, inklusive landing zones och gemensam foundation.
* Omsätta arkitekturprinciper, målarkitektur och standarder till implementerade lösningar.
* Utveckla och underhålla referensarkitekturer, designmönster och tekniska best practices.
* Designa och implementera Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform.
* Standardisera deploymentmönster, templates och CI/CD-pipelines.
* Utveckla plattformskapabiliteter som möjliggör self-service för utvecklingsteamen.
* Leda tekniskt arbete kopplat till migrering, modernisering och optimering av workloads.
* Vidareutveckla säkerhet och governance genom bland annat Azure Policy, RBAC och Zero Trust-principer.
* Förbättra monitorering, loggning, incidenthantering, resiliens och plattformens kostnadseffektivitet.
* Coacha och stötta andra Cloud Engineers och utvecklingsteam i tekniska vägval och arbetssätt.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

**Vi söker**
 Vi söker dig som har djup erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och som trivs med att både designa och själv implementera tekniska lösningar. Du har ett tydligt platform engineering-perspektiv och ser automation, standardisering och säkerhet som naturliga delar av en modern cloudplattform.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:**
* Djup erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure inom plattform, nätverk och säkerhet.
* Stark kompetens inom Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller ARM.
* Erfarenhet av Azure Landing Zones och Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Erfarenhet av DevOps, CI/CD och automatiserade deployments.
* God förståelse för identitet och behörighetsstyrning, exempelvis Entra ID och RBAC.
* Erfarenhet av cloud governance, säkerhet och Zero Trust.
* Förståelse för hybrid IT och integration mellan cloud- och on-prem-miljöer.
* Förmåga att ta tekniskt ledarskap och vägleda andra i design- och implementeringsfrågor.
* God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**
* AKS, Kubernetes eller andra containerplattformar.
* API Management, eventdrivna lösningar eller microservices.
* Komplexa cloudmigreringar och moderniseringsinitiativ.
* FinOps och kostnadsoptimering i Azure.
* Att etablera eller vidareutveckla ett platform engineering-team.


 Som person är du strukturerad, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du har förmåga att se helheten samtidigt som du gärna arbetar hands-on. Du är trygg i att påverka tekniska beslut, samarbetar väl över teamgränser och drivs av att skapa lösningar som är användbara, hållbara och enkla för andra team att använda.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
 Hos oss på OKQ8 får du arbeta i en flexibel miljö med viktiga och varierande arbetsuppgifter. Vi uppmuntrar samarbete, innovation och utveckling – och vi tror på att vi tillsammans gör varandra bättre. Här blir du en del av en familjär kultur där vi stöttar varandra, har roligt tillsammans och där du ges möjlighet att växa och göra skillnad. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som minskar utanförskap och främjar mångfald.
   

  

**Övrig information**
 Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen vänligen kontakta Talent Partner Nabila Ur-Rehman;
   

  

**Placeringsort:** 
 Stockholm, Sveavägen.
   

  

**Tillträde:** 
 Enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

**Anställningsform:** 
 Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning
   

  

 För den här tjänsten behöver du vara medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige eller vara asylsökande med rätt att arbeta. Du ska kunna styrka ditt medborgarskap eller din rätt att arbeta i Sverige under rekryteringsprocessen.
   

  

*I rekryteringsprocessen ingår både psykometriska tester och kompetensbaserade intervjuer, med syfte att främja en rättvis utvärdering för alla kandidater.*
**Välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: AI Cloud Engineer
description:
**AI Cloud Engineer (DevOps) | Stockholm - ONSITE | B2B Contract - 12 Months** 




  





 Want to work at the point where AI stops being a demo and starts being production infrastructure?
 



  





 We're hiring an AI Cloud Engineer with strong DevOps experience to join an established engineering organisation in Stockholm. You'll define, build and run the cloud environments that AI solutions actually live on, working shoulder to shoulder with development teams to keep those platforms secure, scalable and fit for purpose.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 



* Gathering requirements and designing end to end AI solutions
* Deploying and managing AI workloads in cloud-based environments
* Installing, configuring and maintaining AI environments
* Helm-based Kubernetes deployments and application installation
* Building and evolving CI/CD and automation pipelines
* Troubleshooting AI-related issues and providing technical support
* Tracking what's new in AI and translating it into something practical



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, computer engineering, electronics or similar
* Very strong Linux. A Linux or Kubernetes certification is a plus
* Software development background, with Python and/or Go
* Proven experience building and running cloud-native Kubernetes environments, ideally data-heavy ones
* Documented production experience with Helm
* CI/CD and automation with ArgoCD, Jenkins or equivalent
* Pipeline experience covering build, unit, integration and end to end testing, SAST/DAST, Artifactory release and deployment through test, staging and production
* DevSecOps mindset with a security-first approach, including scanning third-party libraries and container images for vulnerabilities
* Comfortable in agile teams, with excellent communication in English



  





**Nice to have** 




 Agentic AI or Microsoft Copilot, machine learning, AI software architecture, Kubernetes Operators, AI certifications (Google, AWS or Microsoft), NVIDIA Developer certification, SAFe or similar, and LLM concepts such as prompting and RAG.
 



  





**The details** 




 Full-time, onsite in Stockholm. Long-term assignment with very strong extension prospects. Interviews are happening on a rolling basis, so early applications are best.
 



  





 Please note: the successful candidate will need to pass background screening and security vetting prior to start.
 



  





 Interested? Apply here or message me directly.
