 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Digital & IT är hjärtat i Länsförsäkringsgruppens digitala utveckling. Vi driver den gemensamma digitala transformationen och levererar förstklassiga IT-lösningar, datadrivna insikter och innovativa digitala tjänster som skapar värde för hela verksamheten. Vårt uppdrag är att bygga en robust och framtidssäker IT-miljö – både på plats och i molnet – som möjliggör kundnära och effektiva affärer i hela gruppen.
   

  

 Hos oss möts teknik, affär och innovation. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt ute i verksamheten i agila team där utveckling, drift och strategi går hand i hand. Vi ansvarar för allt från IT-styrning, enterprisearkitektur och leverantörshantering till applikationsutveckling, cybersäkerhet och verksamhetsberedskap.

title: Founding CTO
description:
**The Opportunity** 




  





 We’re working with an early-stage technology company building an AI-powered revenue management and enterprise automation platform for large international organisations.
 



  





 The business already has paying enterprise customers, further major enterprise discussions underway and a seven-person distributed engineering/product team.
 



  





 They are now looking for a Founding CTO to join the founding team, take ownership of the technology strategy and build the engineering organisation as the company scales.
 



  





 This isn't a blank-sheet build. A substantial platform already exists, and the Founding CTO will inherit a strong technical foundation while having the freedom to shape its future architecture and technology.
 



  





**The Role** 




**You’ll take ownership of:** 



* Technology strategy, architecture and technical roadmap
* Enterprise automation and agentic AI systems
* Scalability, security and engineering quality
* Building and leading a Swedish/European engineering team
* Technical and security discussions with enterprise customers
* Technology and architecture decisions as the platform scales



  





 The role will initially be hands-on, moving towards predominantly technical and organisational leadership as the team grows.
 



  





**About You** 




**We’re looking for someone with:** 



* Strong software engineering and systems architecture experience
* Experience with enterprise automation, agentic AI or workflow systems
* A background building scalable enterprise applications
* Strong security understanding
* The credibility to work directly with large enterprise customers
* Hands-on development capability
* A technology-agnostic approach to architecture
* The ambition to build and lead an engineering organisation



  





**The Setup** 




  





 The team currently works together in Sweden around 3–4 days per week, alongside distributed engineers internationally.
 



  





 Initially, the Founding CTO will contribute approximately 20–30 hours per week, with flexibility around when those hours are worked. Following the planned fundraising round, the position will transition to full-time.
 



  





 The initial arrangement is primarily equity-based, transitioning to a market-rate salary + meaningful founder-level equity following fundraising.
 



  





 A rare opportunity to join an already functioning and commercially validated platform as Founding CTO, with genuine ownership over the technology, team and future direction of the business.

title: Consultant/Senior Consultant for our Human Capital team with ServiceNow experience
description:
Deloitte is a leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and related services. During its 175-year history, our organization has grown tremendously in both scale and capabilities. Deloitte currently has approximately 457,000 people in more than 150 countries and territories and serves four out of five Fortune Global 500® companies. Yet, our shared culture and mission—to make an impact that matters—remains unchanged.
   

  

  




**Job Description**

 As a senior consultant, you will work for a wide range of leading and multinational companies. You will play a critical role as a digital HR specialist joining our HR Strategy & Technology project teams and collaborating closely with the functional teams across both the Nordics and elsewhere in Europe in order to design fit-for-purpose solutions for our clients. You will be educated and certified according to your background and interests. This position can be based either in Stockholm or Malmö.
   

  

  





 In this role, you will make an impact by:
   

  

  




* Develop comprehensive HR strategies aligned with organizational goals and objectives, collaborating closely with clients, management teams, and stakeholders through interviews, meetings, and workshops.


* Collaborate with project teams to design high-quality deliverables, including documents and presentations, for client projects.


* Translate business requirements into technical design user stories and configurations


* Support organizational change and user adoption by designing functional solutions, defining and optimizing business processes, configuring SN architecture, and guiding final deliverables through Go-Live.


* Provide advice on innovative ideas and how to use them - such as shared service center technology, and how to leverage them effectively.


**Qualifications**

 We’re looking for a curious and analytical thinker who enjoys crafting creative solutions to complex challenges. You communicate your ideas clearly and confidently, helping others understand and embrace your advice. A passion for emerging technologies and innovation, combined with the ability to offer strategic insights on leveraging technology to boost efficiency and enhance the employee experience, will help you thrive in this role. You value close collaboration with clients and enjoy working in fast-paced, diverse, and multidisciplinary teams.
   

  

  





 You have the following skills and experience:
   

  

  




* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, IT, or a related field


* 2-4 years of experience in similar position


* Implementation experience of HR technology (HRIS, ServiceNow) in complex organizations


* Existing experience or ambition to work with ServiceNow HR

 If you have the following, it will be considered as a plus:

 At Deloitte, we are committed to helping our employees grow and develop throughout their career. We also provide the necessary training and resources for you to obtain various certifications to further advance in your career.
   

  

  





 Our culture is built on collaboration and innovation. We value diverse perspectives and encourage our employees to think creatively to find the best solutions for our clients. We work hand-in-hand with our clients to understand their unique needs and to develop tailored solutions that drive growth and innovation. At Deloitte, you´ll have the chance to grow and succeed alongside like-minded professionals who share your passion.

 Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.
   

  

  





 Send your CV and cover letter. In your cover letter (no more than 200 words), please describe your motivation and answer these following questions:
   

  

  




1. Can you describe a HR technology / ServiceNow transformation project you have been a part of? Please include how you assessed the current state challenges and needs, and how you defined the future solution.


1. What key factors do you consider when advising a client on their future technology design?

 At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success.

title: AI Evaluation Methodology Lead
description:
**Job Description**
 Do you want to define the evaluation methodology and technical requirements that underpin effective AI evaluation and monitoring within the business at one of the leading financial institutions in the Nordics?
   

  

 Join Danske Bank's newly established AI Model Assessment team in Business Controls & Product Management. As AI Evaluation Methodology & Platform Requirements Lead, you will hold a 1st Line of Defence role with clear ownership of the technical methodologies used to evaluate AI models and AI-enabled solutions, and of the technical requirements for the platforms that support their evaluation and ongoing monitoring. You will translate business-owned risk and control needs into clear methods, metrics, data, evidence, traceability and platform capabilities that can be implemented consistently across the Bank's technology landscape.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to shape a consistent, scalable and evidence-based capability through which the business identifies, evaluates, monitors and manages AI model risk.
   

  

 This role can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark, Vilnius, Lithuania, Warsaw, Poland, Stockholm, Sweden or Helsinki, Finland.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 The AI Model Assessment team is a business-owned control capability that performs evidence-based assessments of AI models and AI-enabled solutions across the Bank. We work with business owners, developers, engineers and platform teams to understand how solutions operate, define the evidence required for assessment, and establish the evaluation and monitoring capabilities needed to identify, assess and manage model risk where it arises.
   

  

 Our mission is to enable responsible innovation by providing the business with a consistent and scalable framework for evaluating AI systems, monitoring their performance and risk, and demonstrating that appropriate controls are operating effectively.
   

  

 As AI Evaluation Methodology & Platform Requirements Lead, you will own the evaluation methodology and define the technical requirements for the platforms, tooling and data capabilities used by the 1st Line of Defence to evaluate and monitor AI models and AI-enabled solutions. Your mandate is to ensure that the business has robust, implementable and auditable means to assess its AI risks and controls. Your focus will be on specifying what the evaluation and monitoring capability must deliver rather than owning software development or platform operations.
   

  

 You will work closely with the independent 2nd Line AI model risk function, which sets the overarching risk framework and provides oversight and constructive challenge. You will translate that framework into practical evaluation methodologies, technical requirements and business-owned controls, provide transparent evidence of how requirements are implemented, and support the resolution of identified gaps.
   

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* Owning, developing and maintaining the methodology for evaluating AI models and AI-enabled solutions, including evaluation objectives, test approaches, acceptance criteria and evidence standards.
* Defining the functional and technical requirements for evaluation and monitoring platforms that enable risk management, including data ingestion, test execution, metric calculation, observability, evidence capture, reporting, access controls and auditability.
* Translating model risk, business and assessment requirements into reusable evaluation methods, representative datasets, metrics, thresholds, monitoring indicators and structured evidence requirements.
* Determining how AI system architectures, components, dependencies and data flows affect evaluation scope, test design, monitoring coverage and the technical capabilities required from supporting platforms.
* Defining platform-agnostic requirements that support evaluation and monitoring across environments such as AWS Bedrock and AgentCore, Databricks, Azure OpenAI and embedded third-party AI platforms.
* Setting requirements for reproducibility and end-to-end traceability across models, prompts, datasets, configurations, system components, evaluation results, monitoring signals and changes over time.
* Prioritising opportunities to standardise and automate evaluation and monitoring activities, and working with evaluators, platform owners and engineers to convert approved control requirements into practical platform capabilities.
* Engaging with the Second Line model risk function to interpret applicable requirements, demonstrate how they are operationalised, respond to constructive challenge, and ensure that evaluation and monitoring evidence supports effective independent oversight.


**About You**
 An experienced AI evaluation, model risk, data, architecture or platform professional who can establish rigorous evaluation methodologies and turn business risk and control needs into clear, implementable technical requirements for enterprise platforms and tooling.
   

  

 You have:
   

  

* Proven experience designing or governing AI/ML evaluation methodologies, including test objectives, datasets, metrics, thresholds, acceptance criteria and evidence standards.
* Experience translating evaluation, monitoring, risk and control needs into functional and technical requirements for platforms, tooling, data pipelines and reporting capabilities.
* Experience with AI/ML evaluation, business-owned model risk management and controls, technical assurance, MLOps, LLMOps, AI platforms or AI observability.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services or enterprise AI platforms; experience with AWS Bedrock or AgentCore, Databricks or Mosaic AI, Azure OpenAI, or comparable platforms is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of evaluation and monitoring principles, including representative datasets, experiment configuration, metric design, regression testing, monitoring indicators, traceability and evidence capture.
* Ability to distinguish methodology and requirements ownership from platform implementation, while collaborating effectively with engineers and platform owners. Python or similar tools for analysis, prototyping or investigation are an advantage, but software development is not the primary focus of the role.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate evaluation, monitoring, risk and control requirements across business, assessment, platform, engineering, architecture, data and risk functions.


 Experience with AI evaluation or observability technologies, for example Phoenix or comparable tools, is an advantage but is not a prerequisite.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 You will join the newly established AI Model Assessment team in Business Controls & Product Management, helping build the Bank's consistent and scalable business-owned capability for AI evaluation, monitoring and model risk management.
   

  

 The team combines technical AI evaluation expertise with model risk management and works across the Bank's AI initiatives. In this role, you will connect evaluators with platform, engineering, architecture and data teams by defining the methods and technical requirements their solutions must support, ensuring that risk ownership and control evidence remain anchored in the business.
   

  

 If hired in Lithuania, your monthly salary would range from
 **4320 EUR** 
 to
 **6480 EUR** 
 gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).
   

  

 Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package which includes:
   

  

* Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.
* Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.
* Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.
* Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.
* Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.


**See all the benefits** 
**HERE** 
**.**
 Your job function (position) in the job contract will be AI Science
   

  

**Are you ready for the next step?**
 If you are passionate about defining robust AI evaluation methodologies and the technical requirements for scalable evaluation and monitoring platforms that support effective business ownership of AI risk, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

 For questions about the role, please contact
 **Khaled Alizai** 
 , Head of AI Model Assessment at khali@danskebank.dk. We are screening the applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 Join us and help build the business-owned foundation for effective AI model evaluation, monitoring and risk management at Danske Bank.

title: Test Engineering Lead, Electronics
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Test and Validation Engineer to join our Hardware & Firmware organisation in Stockholm. You'll own how we test the electronics the team designs, and you'll build the fixtures and boards that make that testing possible.
   

  

 Every new PCB revision comes through you for bring-up and verification. You'll write the test plans that check a board against its requirements, design the fixtures and test boards that run them, automate what's worth automating, and take failures down to root cause so the fix lands in the next design revision.
   

  

 Our devices have to give the same reading in every clinic, every time. That makes verification a design input, which is why this role sits close to the design work and starts early in a project.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Bring up and verify new PCB revisions across the team's designs
* Design test fixtures and test PCBs yourself, schematic through layout
* Write and execute verification test plans against requirements
* Build automated test setups and the scripting behind them
* Troubleshoot EMC pre-compliance failures and feed what you find back into the design
* Take failures to root cause, and turn the answer into a design change
* Bring test thinking into design reviews early, so boards arrive testable


**What You Bring**
* Hands-on lab skills: oscilloscope, DMM, logic analyser, and bench debugging of real hardware
* Schematic capture and PCB design, enough to build your own test fixtures and test boards
* Test scripting and automation in Python or similar
* Strong analogue and digital fundamentals
* Able to read a requirement and say how you'd test it, including when it isn't testable as written
* Comfortable owning the test approach for a board and explaining the reasoning behind it
* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics or equivalent practical experience
* Fluent English (C1 or above)


**Bonus points**
* Medical devices or another regulated industry, or familiarity with IEC 60601
* EMC pre-compliance work, particularly time spent in a chamber with a failure
* Sensor signal conditioning and analogue front ends
* Instrument control and automated test frameworks: LabVIEW, PyVISA, TestStand
* Design for test on boards heading into volume production


**Why join this team**
 You'd own the test approach for all the hardware this team designs, and you design the fixtures and test boards behind it yourself, schematic through layout. There's real electronics design work inside this role, which is part of why it's a good route towards design engineering if that's where you want to end up.
   

  

 The hierarchy is flat and the design team is in Stockholm with you, so the distance between finding a problem and changing a design is short. You'll be in the design reviews from the start.
   

  

 The hardware you verify goes into clinics and gets used on real people, which is the reason the standard you hold it to matters.

title: AI Risk Evaluator
description:
**Job Description**
 Do you want to work on AI risk management in one of the leading financial institutions in the Nordics?
   

  

 Join Danske Bank's newly established AI Model Assessment team in Business Controls & Product Management, operating as a central 1st Line of Defence capability. You will help build a consistent, evidence-based approach to assessing AI models and AI-enabled solutions across the Bank. As an AI Risk Evaluator, you will assess solutions before deployment and throughout their lifecycle, helping Model Owners and development teams demonstrate that intended use, performance, limitations, risks and controls are understood, tested and documented. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technologies, risk ownership, control execution and financial regulation.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 The AI Model Assessment team is a central 1st Line of Defence capability responsible for supporting the identification, assessment, mitigation and monitoring of risks arising from AI solutions across the Bank. We work closely with Model Owners, business units, data scientists, engineers, model developers and governance functions to translate risk and control requirements into practical assessments, testing and traceable evidence.
   

  

 Our mission is to enable innovation while helping the business fulfil its responsibility to manage AI model risk and deploy AI systems in a safe, robust and well-governed manner.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 As an AI Risk Evaluator, you will operate within the Bank's 1st Line of Defence, performing lifecycle assessments that help Model Owners and business areas exercise their accountability for AI model risk, execute effective controls, address weaknesses and maintain decision-useful evidence. You will provide assessment evidence and respond to objective challenge from relevant 2nd Line of Defence function, which retain responsibility for oversight and, where applicable, validation.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Conducting assessments of foundation models, GenAI applications, AI agents, and traditional machine learning models.
* Understanding the business process, intended use, technical architecture, human oversight and potential impact of a solution as the basis for an appropriate evaluation.
* Translating identified risk and control requirements into testable evaluation objectives, metrics, datasets and acceptance criteria.
* Providing robust challenge to use-case owners, model developers and other stakeholders regarding assumptions, risks, controls and evaluation evidence.
* Designing and executing evaluations covering model performance, robustness, hallucination and grounding, harmful behaviour, prompt injection, overreliance and other relevant failure modes.
* Assessing the quality, representativeness and limitations of evaluation data; identifying risks and control weaknesses; and producing clear, traceable findings and recommendations to support risk acceptance, governance and deployment decisions.
* Contributing evaluation findings to reusable methodologies, test assets and minimum assessment standards.
* Preparing complete and reproducible assessment evidence for independent review, challenge and, where applicable, validation by relevant Second Line of Defence functions.
* Supporting Model Owners and development teams in addressing findings, strengthening controls and reassessing solutions following material changes or identified issues.


 This position can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark, Vilnius, Lithuania, Warsaw, Poland, Stockholm, Sweden or Helsinki, Finland.
   

  

**About You**
 An experienced AI or machine learning professional with a strong understanding of AI technologies and the risks they introduce.
   

  

 Ideally, you have:
   

  

* Extensive experience working with AI, machine learning, model validation, model risk management, AI governance, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and modern AI architectures.
* Ability to connect technical findings with enterprise risks, controls, business processes and governance decisions.
* Experience evaluating AI systems from a technical and risk perspective.

title: Postdoktor med inriktning mot autonoma system och bemannade–obemannade förband i markstrid
description:
Försvarshögskolans (FHS) Markcentrum vid FHS Institut för krigföring söker en postdoktor med inriktning mot obemannade system (UxS) och bemannade–obemannade förband i markstrid. Postdoktorn ska bidra till ett forskningsprojekt som fokuserar på den växande betydelsen av obemannade farkoster i förbandssammanhang och hur dessa kan integreras i framtida markstridsförband. Projektet fokuserar särskilt på samspelet mellan bemannade och obemannade plattformar (”manned–unmanned teaming”) i framtida manöverförband.
   

  

 Av särskilt intresse är att skapa en helhetsbild kring hur obemannade system samverkar med bemannade förband, ledningssystem och övriga förmågor i ett samlat stridssystem. Projektet kan omfatta svenska och internationella fallstudier, doktrin- och taktikanalys, modellering och simulering, spel/experiment eller andra metoder som är lämpliga för att belysa forskningsfrågorna. Syftet är att ta fram kunskap som kan stödja utformningen och utvecklingen av framtida svenska markstridsförband, med särskilt fokus på Försvarsmaktens behov.
   

  

 Ett centralt tema är blandningen av bemannade stridsfordon, markbaserade obemannade system och flygande obemannade system i markdomänen, med såväl lättare som tyngre plattformar och olika vapensystem. Projektet studerar hur denna mix påverkar organisation, taktik, ledning, sensorer, vapensystem, logistik och sårbarhet.
   

  

 Försvarshögskolans Markcentrum och FHS institut för krigföring (IFK) forskar och utvecklar primärt för det militära försvarets behov. Våra bidrag kan vara inriktade på förmågeutveckling, kompetensutveckling såväl som kunskapsutveckling och att bygga system för militär flexibilitet. IFK är en mötesplats och en plattform för samarbete inom Försvarshögskolan och med Försvarsmakten såväl som med andra partners inom försvarsvarssektorn både nationellt och internationellt. Markcentrum har ett särskilt ansvar för markdomänen.
   

  

 Anställningen kommer att ha sin grundplacering på Institutionen för Försvarssystem. Försvarssystem är ett ämne i skärningen mellan samhällsvetenskap och ingenjörsvetenskap. Forskningen och undervisningen inom ämnet handlar om system som bidrar till eller påverkar samhällets försvar där både tekniska och sociala komponenter ingår. I ämnet försvarssystem är utgångspunkten att tekniska och sociala komponenter inte kan studeras isolerat från varandra. I fokus står studiet av utveckling, anskaffning och användning av teknologi och materiel för försvar och säkerhet.
   

  

 Projektet genomförs i nära samverkan med Försvarsmakten och armén, och resultaten förväntas bidra direkt till deras förbands- och konceptutveckling.
   

  

 Arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Den huvudsakliga arbetsuppgiften är att bidra till forskningsprojektet genom att bedriva egen forskning och forskning med övriga projektmedlemmar. Arbetet har en tydlig tillämpad inriktning där du, tillsammans med övriga projektmedlemmar, tar fram underlag, analyser och rekommendationer som är direkt användbara för försvarsmakten. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att sprida kunskap genom att publicera vetenskapliga artiklar och presentera forskningsresultat, exempelvis vid internationella konferenser. Vidare ingår att föreläsa i relevanta utbildningar, seminarier och workshops hos Försvarsmakten, särskilt Armén, att delta i avrapporteringsseminarier med Försvarsmakten, samt ha en beredskap att stödja relevanta studier, workshops och utbildningar inom Försvarsmakten om det efterfrågas.
   

  

 I anställningen ingår upp till 20% undervisning.
   

  

 Vad vi söker
   

  

 Den sökande ska ha avlagt doktorsexamen eller en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen i ett ämne med relevans för projektet. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid examens relevans för forskningsprojektet. I första hand beaktas sökande som avlagt doktorsexamen högst tre år före sista ansökningsdag.
   

  

* Ha förmåga att självständigt bedriva forskning inom ramen för forskningsprojektet.
* Ha god kunskap inom forskningsområdet. Kunskap inom obemannade system (UxS) och bemannade–obemannade förband i markstrid är meriterande.
* Kunna kommunicera forskningsresultat till Försvarsmakten, särskilt Armén, på ett tydligt och mottagaranpassat sätt.
* Ha språkkunskaper på avancerad nivå i engelska. Kunskaper i svenska är meriterande.
* Ha intresse för och gärna erfarenhet av att bedriva praktiknära forskning i nära samverkan med Försvarsmakten, särskilt Armén.


 Vi ser att du har god samarbetsförmåga, hög social kompetens och trivs i mötet med nya människor. Du är självgående som person och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter. Vidare är du strukturerad och analytisk. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personliga egenskaper. Du trivs i en miljö där forskare, officerare och andra praktiker samarbetar tätt.
   

  

 För att trivas hos oss behöver du vara engagerad och närvarande och du vill bidra till Försvarshögskolans professionella utveckling, kollegiala samarbetskultur och sociala sammanhållning. Det faller sig vidare naturligt för dig att dela med dig av din kunskap och bidra till att skapa en givande och god arbetsmiljö.
   

  

 Om anställningen
   

  

 Detta är en tidsbegränsad heltidsanställning på två år med möjlighet till ett års förlängning beroende på finansiering.
   

  

 Denna anställning är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten.
   

  

 Anställningen kan komma att innefatta krigsplacering. Om du redan är krigsplacerad i din nuvarande anställning på en myndighet och din kompetens behövs i Försvarshögskolans krigsorganisation sker det en förhandling mellan berörd myndighet och Försvarshögskolan om var du ska vara placerad.
   

  

 Tillträde
   

  

 Enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

**Lön och förmåner**
 Försvarshögskolan tillämpar individuell lönesättning.
   

  

 Läs om förmåner för anställda vid Försvarshögskolan via denna länk.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

**Din Ansökan Bör Innehålla**
* ett personligt brev med din motivering att söka denna tjänst
* ditt CV inklusive publikationslista och (planerat) datum för doktorsexamen
* en forskningsplan på max. 2 sidor där du beskriver ditt forskningsintresse och förhållningssätt till detta projekt
* beskrivning av specifika projekt av relevans för tjänsten där du har deltagit
* dina tidigare publikationer av relevans för tjänsten (max. 10)


 Ansökan skickas in via Försvarshögskolans rekryteringssystem.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 23 september 2026!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Är du en erfaren DevOps Engineer med intresse för teknik och att ständigt utvecklas? Vill du hjälpa våra kunder att göra världen lite bättre genom digitala lösningar?
   

  

 I DevOps-rollen på HiQ kommer du arbeta i varierande kunduppdrag i en rad olika branscher (exempelvis finans, retail, industri och försvar) där du bidrar med din expertis och kunskap. Du blir en viktig del i det tekniska teamet där ditt engagemang för utveckling och drift skapar utrymme för att effektivisera och automatisera mjukvaruutvecklingen av framtidens digitala tjänster.
   

  

 Som DevOps Engineer har du särskilt fokus på att designa, bygga och vidareutveckla CI/CD‑pipelines och automationslösningar som gör det snabbt, säkert och förutsägbart att gå från kod till produktion. Du arbetar tätt tillsammans med utveckling, test och drift och tar ett tydligt ansvar för bygg- och leveransflödena hos våra kunder.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* Högskole-/universitetsexamen i datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller annan relevant inriktning
* Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet av DevOps‑arbete med tydligt fokus på CI/CD, build och release
* Erfarenhet av att bygga och förvalta CI/CD‑pipeliner
* Mycket god vana av att automatisera bygg, test och deploy
* Erfarenhet av versionshantering i större utvecklingsteam
* Erfarenhet av testautomatisering och integration av tester i pipelines
* Förmåga att analysera och förbättra bygg- och leveransflöden
* Svenskt medborgarskap samt flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


 Meriterande
   

  

* Erfarenhet av virtualiserade eller molnbaserade byggmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av att agera teknisk ägare för CI/CD i större utvecklingsorganisationer


 Vi erbjuder dig
   

  

 Hos oss får du utmanande uppdrag både ute i våra kunders organisationer och i vår egen regi, där HiQ har helhetsansvar för projekten. Du får möjlighet att delta i utvecklingen av våra kunders framtida tjänster som förenklar människors vardag, tillsammans med kunniga kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sina kunskaper och erfarenheter. Vi erbjuder en kreativ arbetsmiljö där du kan utvecklas som människa, kollega och bli ännu bättre på det du redan är bäst på, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett värderingsstyrt bolag som värdesätter glädje och gemenskap och som hittar på mycket roligt tillsammans.
   

  

 Varför HiQ
   

  

 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. HiQ har alltid fokuserat på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar utöver förväntningar – det är vad som driver oss framåt! Vi HiQare är stolta över att ha en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra gemensamma mål och strävar efter att hjälpa varandra att fortsätta växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du utöver chansen att utveckla din egen kompetens också möjlighet att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå urvalsfrågor, intervjuer, tekniska tester, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Master thesis: Adapting Neural Networks to New Tasks
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 In the Research Area Artificial Intelligence, which is part of Ericsson Research, we are pushing the technology frontiers in AI, combining machine learning and reasoning methods, tools, and techniques to drive intelligent autonomous operations in large complex telecom systems.
   

  

*We are now looking for a talented and motivated student to join us for a study on adaptation of neural network architectures for changing machine-learning tasks.*
 In the telecommunication world, machine-learning problems are dynamic. Frequent changes in network conditions, available data, and operational objectives create distributional shifts, evolving feature spaces, and entirely new learning tasks. The neural network architecture tailored for an initial state of the problem may therefore become suboptimal over time, leading to degraded performance and increased maintenance costs.
   

  

 In this thesis, you will investigate whether model architecture adaptation can maintain and improve the model performance over time. You will leverage and further refine ideas from Continual Learning and Neural Architecture Search to develop more flexible and resilient machine-learning systems.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Conduct literature review in the areas of continual learning, neural architecture search, and machine-learning in telecommunications
* Evaluate existing solutions in the area to establish a baseline
* Develop and evaluate your own approach for adapting neural architectures for improved model performance
* Collaborate with your supervisor to define research directions
* Collaborate with research team to ensure technical feasibility
* Present findings through regular discussions and final thesis documentation


**The skills you bring:**
* Master’s student with most courses completed and strong academic performance
* Knowledge of continual learning, deep learning, or neural architecture search is a plus
* Proficiency in Python programming
* Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch
* Strong programming, debugging, and problem-solving skills, including effective use of generative AI development tools
* Excellent communication skills
* Excellent written and spoken English, ability to work as part of an international team
* Knowledge in telecommunication networks


 As the work is research-oriented, we expect an analytical mindset, the ability to learn quickly, work independently, and identify problems and solutions.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 The project will be conducted in Kista during Spring 2027, as part of our activities at Ericsson Research. You will be offered mentorship from experienced researchers at Ericsson Research, access to industry tools and datasets, and an opportunity to support Ericsson initiatives towards an AI-native network. Further, outstanding results may contribute to scientific publications, patent applications, and future Ericsson research activities.

title: Master Thesis: ML-Based Analysis of Classical and Quantum Random Number Generators
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 Ericsson is looking for a master’s thesis student in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering with strong deep-learning skills and an interest in sequence modelling,
   

  

 information security, or applied research.
   

  

 Random-number generators are critical components of secure communication and cryptographic systems. NIST SP 800-22 provides a suite of statistical tests for assessing binary sequences, while NIST SP 800-90B defines methods for estimating min-entropy, including Markov and predictor-based estimators. These methods were developed before the emergence of modern machine-learning techniques.
   

  

 This thesis investigates whether compact Transformer-based sequence models, trained from scratch on binary data, can extend and complement established NIST randomness and entropy-evaluation methods. By learning to predict the next bit or block in a sequence, the model performs a generalised prediction and compression task related to methods already used in existing standards. Its prediction performance can therefore be studied as a potential statistical test for detecting dependencies and entropy deficiencies.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 In this thesis, you will conduct a literature review of machine-learning-based extensions and alternatives to established randomness tests. You will design, implement, and compare compact Transformer architectures trained from scratch for next-bit and next-block prediction on binary sequences.
   

  

 You will evaluate the resulting model-based test using weak pseudorandom number generators, NIST SP 800-90A Deterministic Random Bit Generators—including Hash\_DRBG, HMAC\_DRBG, and CTR\_DRBG - and data from a Quantum Random Number Generator available at Ericsson.
   

  

 You will compare the models’ results with established statistical randomness tests and analyse the relationship between prediction performance, compression-based measures, and min-entropy estimates from NIST SP 800-90B, including predictor-based methods such as Lag, MultiMMC, and LZ78Y.
   

  

 The main objective is to determine whether machine-learning-based prediction can reveal statistical dependencies or entropy deficiencies that conventional methods may not detect. Any differences observed between PRNG and QRNG data must be interpreted carefully, as they may arise from device bias, preprocessing, formatting, or other dataset-specific artifacts rather than from a uniquely quantum signature.
   

  

**The skills you bring:**
* Enrolled in the final year of an MSc programme in Physics, Engineering Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Cybersecurity, or a closely related field.
* Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Ability to design, implement, train, and evaluate neural-network architectures from scratch.
* Good understanding of probability, statistics, information theory, and fundamental machine-learning concepts.
* Familiarity with data preparation, training and validation workflows, performance evaluation, and reproducible experimentation.
* Understanding of binary data representation and sequential data processing.
* Experience with Transformers, sequence modelling, natural language processing, or time-series analysis is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with NumPy, pandas, and scikit-learn, or a demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new tools quickly.
* Basic knowledge of randomness, entropy estimation, statistical testing, cryptography, or pseudorandom and quantum random-number generation is advantageous.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English.
* Ability to work independently, manage a 20-week research project, document results, and communicate findings clearly through technical reports and presentations.


**Why join Ericsson?**
 At Ericsson, you will have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what is possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You will be challenged, but you won’t be alone. title: Master Thesis: Quantum geometry as a diagnostic  framework for quantum kernel classifiers
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Ericsson is looking for a Master's thesis student with a strong background in quantum computing, physics, computer science, and machine learning to work on quantum machine learning (QML) and quantum geometry. This thesis explores how the geometric structure of quantum circuits - captured by the Quantum Geometric Tensor (QGT) - can be used to understand, optimize, and characterize quantum kernel classifiers running on real quantum hardware. You will investigate three interconnected research questions: when and why a quantum kernel outperforms a classical one; how variational quantum circuits can be trained more efficiently using geometry-aware optimization; and how hardware noise on a real quantum processor distorts the geometric structure of a quantum classifier. The work combines quantum information theory, differential geometry, and applied machine learning, with a concrete application in enterprise IT security. IBM Q hardware access is available for experimental validation.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 In this thesis you will develop a geometric framework for quantifying quantum kernel advantage over classical kernels using the Fubini–Study metric and the Quantum Fisher Information Matrix. You will implement and compare geometry-aware optimization (quantum natural gradient) against standard optimizers for variational quantum circuit training and investigate how hardware noise distorts the geometric structure of quantum circuits by comparing multiple open-system QGT constructions (Bures/Uhlmann, Sjöqvist, covariant-derivative) as noise diagnostics on real IBM Q hardware. You will apply the framework to an enterprise security classification task (anomaly detection under limited-data conditions) and benchmark against classical machine learning baselines.
   

  

**The skills you bring:**
* Enrolled in the final year of an MSc programme in Physics, Engineering Physics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field.

* Ability to work independently, manage a 20-week research project, and communicate findings clearly in writing and presentation.

* Understanding of the Quantum Geometric Tensor, quantum metric (Fubini–Study metric), Berry curvature, or related concepts from quantum geometry or quantum information is a strong advantage.

title: Master thesis: Latent Neural-Operator Structural Causal Models
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Ericsson Research’s Artificial Intelligence Research Area combines machine learning and reasoning to enable intelligent, autonomous operations in complex telecom systems.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated student to study Latent Neural-Operator Structural Causal Models.
   

  

 Causal representation learning asks whether hidden causal variables can be recovered from observed measurements. Existing theory often assumes scalar variables and unstructured mixing. In physical systems, causal variables may instead be functions defined on different domains, while the measurement process has known structure.
   

  

 A radio link is a clear example. Channel response, interference, and the equalised constellation are function-valued and not directly observable. Receiver IQ samples and channel estimates combine them with hardware impairments and transmitter choices.
   

  

 This project will study a latent structural causal model for such systems. Function-valued latent variables are connected through operator mechanisms, while the measurement chain links latent structure to observed data. The structure is known, the mechanisms are not, and system actions are logged with known targets.
   

  

 The thesis will assess whether the recovered latent structure is meaningful, not merely whether it reconstructs measurements. Two criteria will be evaluated:
   

  

* Identifiability: Do the recovered latents correspond to the true variables, and are they determined by the measurement model, logged interventions, or both? For function-valued variables, ambiguity may involve transformations of entire function spaces.
* Compositional generalisation: Can a causal-graph model predict untested combinations of interventions better than an unstructured model?


 You will implement the framework in a link-level simulator with known ground truth and compare it with causal representation learning baselines. Negative results are valid outcomes; showing that the latent structure is not meaningful or that the graph provides no benefit is also valuable.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Review causal representation learning and identifiability literature.
* Build a controlled physical-layer simulator with known ground truth.
* Implement the proposed model and comparison baselines.
* Evaluate identifiability and prediction of untested interventions.
* Present findings in regular discussions and the final thesis, including negative results.


**The skills you bring:**
* A largely completed master’s degree with strong academic performance.
* Knowledge of machine learning, linear algebra, and probability.
* Proficiency in Python and experience with PyTorch or JAX.
* Ability to work independently and use AI coding assistants effectively.
* Excellent written and spoken English and teamwork skills.
* Interest in causal inference or signal processing is beneficial.


 We expect an analytical, research-oriented mindset, the ability to learn quickly, and the initiative to identify problems and solutions.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Senior Backend Developer (Python), you'll build and shape the engine room of Filed:
   

  

* The Python services that power tax computation, document processing, and agentic workflows at scale
* Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work
* The data pipelines that move documents, returns, and evidence reliably through the most intense weeks of tax season


 You'll own the architecture end to end, set the technical bar for the services the whole product stands on, and see your decisions carry real weight for some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Designing, building, and operating backend services across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the architecture, APIs, and data models that the rest of the product is built on
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Making LLM-powered pipelines reliable, observable, and accurate in production
* Raising the bar for the engineers around you through reviews, pairing, and example


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Deep Python experience: you've designed, built, and operated production services and APIs at scale
* Deep understanding of building in agent first way, using coding agents daily and controlling LLM driven workflows.
* Strong grasp of distributed systems, data modeling, queues, and the failure modes that come with them
* Strong React/Typescript: you know how to control systems not just backend related
* Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 4 (Senior). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 82,500 SEK per month + $180,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 90,000 SEK per month + $120,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 97,500 SEK per month + $60,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you're earlier in your journey than this role expects, that's not a problem. Apply to the Backend Developer (Python) role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.

title: Frontend Developer with focus on UX/UI

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Frontend Developer with a strong UX/UI focus, or a UX/UI Designer with frontend development chops, to join one of our expanding engineering teams.
 



  





 You'll play a key role in shaping the look, feel, and interactivity of products that reach a global audience—contributing not only to how things work but also how they feel. At Evolution, design and development are not siloed; you'll be an essential part of product decisions from day one, working in highly collaborative, autonomous teams.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design and build intuitive, responsive, and beautiful interfaces with React (Next.js) and TypeScript.
* Bring UX and UI designs to life—from wireframes to pixel-perfect implementation.

 Nolimit City, Stockholm based development team. We provide you with your choice of OS and IDE.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At MedHelp Care, we’re shaping the future of workplace health management. As a leading Nordic B2B SaaS company, we build intelligent AI-powered platforms that help organizations create healthier workplaces.
 



  





 Our platform uses advanced health data analytics and machine learning to detect early signals of health risk, enabling companies to take proactive, preventive action. Our mission is clear: to make workplaces healthier, more resilient, and better equipped to support both employees and organizations.
 



  





 We are on an exciting growth journey, and we’re now looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join us.
 



  





**About the role** 




 You’ll join our data team that develops InsightsHub and Statistics, our customer-facing analytics products; Larix, our model for flagging who’s at risk of long-term sick leave; and the data platform underneath.
 



  





 We use agentic coding tools heavily, and expect how we build to keep changing. We care less about which tools you use today than whether you’re willing to keep changing how you work.
 



  





 Larix, and how we run models in production generally, is at the centre of this role. We’re a small shop, so things move fast and what you build shapes the product rather than a corner of it.
 



  





**What we’re recruiting for** 



* Larix, our long-term sick leave risk model: retraining, serving and monitoring it in production, plus features, evaluation, performance, and making it work in new markets.
* How we run models in production generally – serving, evaluation, and monitoring.



  





**What the team owns and you’ll work across** 



* InsightsHub, our LLM-based analytics product: the data model and pipelines underneath, and the generation on top.
* The transformation layer: dbt, warehouse, orchestration.
* Product and usage data, with a focus on making it self-serve.
* Proving what the product does to sickness absence, in a way that holds up with customers and leadership.



  





**Who we think you are** 



* You write Python and SQL that other people can maintain.
* You’ve looked after a model in production over time, not just built one and moved on.
* You’ve automated a training or deployment pipeline, or you’re keen to.
* You can design an evaluation that survives scrutiny, and you know the difference between correlation, prediction, and causal effect.
* You’ve worked with dbt or equivalent and an orchestrator like Airflow, Prefect or Dagster.
* You can explain what the numbers mean to someone who isn’t technical.
* We’re open to a few years of experience and up. The right person matters more than years of experience.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Taking a model to a new market or population.
* Evaluating LLM or AI output in production.
* Experience with privacy and sensitive personal data.
* Domain background in HR, occupational health, insurance, or healthcare.



  





**About MedHelp Care** 




 MedHelp Care AB is a leading SaaS company offering an AI-powered, cloud-based platform for data-driven corporate health and expert medical advisory services. Used by around 500 companies in the Nordics and connecting up to 200,000 employees, our platform helps reduce sick leave, increase employee presence, and lower costs.
 



 Founded in 1999, we operate in Sweden, Finland, and Denmark with a team of around 45 employees.
 



  





 Our mission is to improve employee health through proactive, data-driven initiatives and contribute to a healthier society by halving long-term sick leave. At the heart of this mission is a machine learning model that helps us identify and address health risks proactively. If you’re motivated by applying machine learning to health, and you’d rather work across the whole lifecycle of a model at a small company than on one slice of it at a large one, this role is for you.
 



  





*In this recruitment, we are collaborating with Safemind, and all applications will be processed through them.*

title: Data Engineer
description:
På Marginalen Bank bygger vi just nu nästa generations dataplattform på Azure Databricks. Vi söker dig som vill ta en nyckelroll i vår resa från traditionell datalagring till en modern lakehouse-plattform där kvalitet, innovation och affärsvärde står i centrum.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




  





 Som Data Engineer i vårt Data Automation-team arbetar du med att utveckla och förvalta bankens nya dataplattform på Azure Databricks.
 



  





 Vi befinner oss mitt i en spännande transformering där vi migrerar från vår befintliga datalösning till en modern lakehouse-plattform baserad på Azure Databricks, Unity Catalog och dbt. Mycket är fortfarande greenfield: du är med och sätter standarder, bygger pipelines och avgör hur plattformen ska fungera i flera år framåt.
 



  





 Teamet är litet och mandatet är stort. Du arbetar nära behovsägare i verksamheten, analytiker och vår plattformsarkitekt, och du får ta ansvar för problem hela vägen från felsökning till lösning.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter:** 




  




* Designa, bygger och optimera datapipelines i Databricks - från ingestion via transformering till serving
* Bygga transformationer i dbt där kvalitet, testning och dokumentation är en naturlig del av utvecklingen
* Modellera data för analys och rapportering samt leverera datamodeller till Power BI
* Migrera och modernisera befintliga dataflöden till vår nya plattform
* Säkerställa hög datakvalitet genom övervakning, felsökning och kontinuerliga förbättringar
* Arbeta med datastyrning, åtkomst, maskning och spårbarhet i Unity Catalog
* Bidra till tekniska vägval kring standarder, verktyg och arbetssätt
* Säkerställa att lösningarna uppfyller bankens krav inom bland annat GDPR och DORA.



  





 Vi använder AI-assistenter som en naturlig del av vårt utvecklingsarbete för att skriva kod, felsöka och utforska nya lösningar. Därför ser vi gärna att du också är bekväm med att använda AI som ett verktyg i din vardag.
 



  





**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:** 




  





 Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet som Data Engineer och som trivs med att bygga moderna, skalbara datalösningar. Du har god erfarenhet av Databricks och arbetar obehindrat i SQL och Python. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av dbt, ETL-pipelines, Git, datamodellering och moderna utvecklingsmetoder ser vi det som en stor fördel.
 



  





 Som person är du analytisk och har förmåga att lösa komplexa problem inom data, pipelines och infrastruktur. Du är även lösningsorienterad och tycker om att ta ansvar från idé till färdig lösning. Du har god kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med både tekniska och affärsnära kollegor och kommunicerar väl på svenska.
 



  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure, Unity Catalog, Power BI eller har arbetat inom bank, finans eller annan reglerad verksamhet. Har du även deltagit i migreringar av dataplattformar eller har ett intresse för AI ser vi det som ett extra plus.
 



  





**Därför ska du välja Marginalen Bank** 




  





 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med modern teknik i en verksamhet där data spelar en allt viktigare roll. Vi kombinerar stabiliteten från bankvärlden med entreprenörsandan hos en organisation som ständigt utvecklas.
 



  





 Vi erbjuder:
 



  




* Möjligheten att bygga en dataplattform från grunden och påverka dess framtida riktning
* En modern tech stack med Azure Databricks, Unity Catalog, dbt och Lakeflow
* Ett kompetent och engagerat team där idéer blir verklighet
* Stort eget ansvar och korta beslutsvägar
* En arbetsmiljö där AI-verktyg är en naturlig del av utvecklingsarbetet
* Goda möjligheter till lärande, utveckling och kompetensutbyte



  





 Vårt huvudkontor ligger mitt i centrala Stockholm, den ikoniska byggnaden ritad av Sigurd Lewerentz. Dessutom har vi en egen restaurang med kock som lagar ekologisk mat varje dag.
 



  





 Vi erbjuder bland annat:
 



  




* Flexibelt arbetssätt
* Tjänstepension
* Hälsoförsäkring
* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Volontärdag
* Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter
* En kultur präglad av engagemang, samarbete och arbetsglädje



  





 Låter det som nästa steg i din karriär?
 



  





 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 18 oktober. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

title: Juniora Analysts till Deloitte Digital (Stockholm) - Jan 2027
description:
Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling.
   

  

  




**Jobbeskrivning**

 Inom Deloitte Digital stödjer du Deloittes kunder med strategi, rådgivning och systemimplementation för att utveckla deras e-handels-, försäljning-, kundservice- och marknadsföringsfunktioner. En stor del av ditt arbete inkluderar implementation av system så som Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Adobe som Commercetools. Förutom systemutveckling bygger Deloitte Digital skräddarsydda lösningar i tech stacks som React, Next.js, Swift, Kotlin. I vårt team finner du utvecklare (frontend / backend), applikationsspecialister, kravanalytiker och verksamhetsutvecklare. Hos oss kommer du kunna stärka din tekniska kompetens och jobba med bland annat utveckling, teknisk arkitektur, data och systemintegration. Du kommer att arbeta nära klient för att stärka deras kundupplevelse genom strategiska och taktiska initiativ samtidigt som du utvecklar djup branschkunskap och verksamhetsförståelse.
   

  

  




**Kvalifikationer**

 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

  




* Är nyexaminerad med en masterexamen inom systemvetenskap eller ingenjörsvetenskap, med inriktning mot data.
* Har relevant arbetserfarenhet eller stort intresse för data, kodning och systemutveckling samt businessförståelse och bransch-kompetens.


 Meriterande:
   

  

  

* Goda studieresultat, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna
* Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv
* Intresse för hur digitalisering / AI och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher


*Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå.*
**Ytterligare information**

**Vi erbjuder**
  

 Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor.
   

  

  





 Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.
   

  

  





**Ansökan**
  

 Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:
   

  

  




* CV


* Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.


 I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.
   

  

  


 Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. https://tofindout.se/sv/faq/. För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen.
   

  

  





**Frågor**
  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare William Lim, wilim@deloitte.se
   

  

  





 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

  





**What impact will you make?**




 På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
ASSA ABLOY Group is a global leader in access solutions, powering secure identities for millions worldwide. Our brands deliver innovative products and services for physical and logical access control, secure authentication, and identity management. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment where creativity, learning, and career growth are encouraged.
   

  

 As an
 **AI/ML Engineer** 
 you willdrive the adoption of artificial intelligence across our products and internal engineering workflows. Join our skilled, international team of developers based in
 **Stockholm (Sweden) or Krak** 
**ó** 
**w (Poland)** 
 , dedicated to building next-generation products and access control systems.
   

  

**The Role:**
 In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI-powered product features while also enabling developers to work more efficiently through AI-assisted coding, agent-based systems, and automated workflows.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of machine learning, software engineering, and product development, turning cutting-edge AI capabilities into practical, scalable solutions that deliver real business value.
   

  

**What you will do as our AI/ML Engineer:**
* Introduce AI tools and workflows that improve developer productivity and code quality.
* Design and implement AI/ML features embedded directly into our products.
* Select, fine-tune, and integrate models (LLMs, classical ML, or hybrid approaches) into production systems.
* Ensure AI solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-efficient.
* Build and maintain AI agents to assist with tasks such as Code generation and refactoring, Test creation, Code reviews and static analysis.
* Help to iterate and improve on best practices for AI usage, governance, and responsible AI implementation.


**The skills and experience you need:**
* Experience in software engineering and a good understanding of ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, deployment).
* Experience working with large language models (LLMs) and AI APIs.
* Programming experience (Python, Java, Go, or similar).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps practices.
* Understanding of data pipelines, feature stores, and monitoring.
* Ability to work effectively in international teams (English fluent), demonstrate creativity and a passion for learning.
* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.


**Nice to have:**
* Experience building multi-agent or tool-using AI systems.
* Knowledge of security evaluation methodologies, cryptography, Secure Elements, secure access control, identification, authentication, and PKI.


**What we offer:**
* Private medical care, life insurance, and MyBenefit cafeteria system.
* In-house English classes, training budget, and broad learning and career development opportunities.
* Additional perks: weekly fresh fruit delivery, meal allowance, and discounts on company products.


**Apply today ! We review applications regularly, so don’t wait.**
 We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner at lea.rein@assaabloy.com
   

  

 Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.
   

  

 Let’s create a safer and more open world - together!
   

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. title: Master Frontier Engineer
description:

**These will help you succeed**

* AI quality and evaluation design experience across agentic systems.
* Technical leadership and advisory skills, with strong client engagement and the ability to mentor engineers.

**What We Offer**
